base_game_loop.summary: Toro Shōgun: paid spin on 4x5 (expands to 10 rows). Up to 1328 paylines. Avalanche/tumble after wins. Bonus modes: Bonus. Round ends on win cap if reached.

phases.name: Place bet and spin
phases.what_happens: Player selects bet and hits Spin (or Auto Spin). Optional: activate an X-iter mode from base game only before the drop/spin.
phases.state_changes: Bet locked; optional X-iter mode selected

phases.name: Initial symbol drop/spin
phases.what_happens: Symbols land on 4x5 (expands to 10 rows). Game-specific setup features may fire (birds, Nitro/COOL reels, collectors, etc.).
phases.ends_when: All symbols at resting positions / reels stopped

phases.name: Remove winners and Avalanche
phases.what_happens: Winning symbols explode/are removed; remaining symbols fall; new symbols drop in. Continues while new wins appear.
phases.ends_when: No new winning combinations after a fill
phases.state_changes: Grid updated; avalanche chain may continue

phases.name: End-of-drop features
phases.what_happens: Resolve end-of-round features (bombs, mystery reveals, row swaps, boosters, etc.) if nothing else can happen; may resume avalanches.

phases.name: Bonus trigger check
phases.what_happens: If bonus/super-bonus trigger conditions met, enter bonus mode after resolving same-drop features. Otherwise settle base-game wins subject to win cap.
phases.state_changes: Enter bonus mode or settle base round

Game description
Toro Shogun is a 5 columns and 4 rows slot with spinning reels and dropping symbols. The Reels can be expanded up to 10 rows and this will unlock the Shogun Mode where the 3 lowest paying symbols are removed from the reels
Toro Shogun comes with the Toro Goes Wild and Matador Respin features and a Free Spins bonus game, all delivered with the classic Toro feeling.

Toro is a Walking Wild that walks one step to the left for each respin or when contributing to a winning combination. Two or more Matador symbols trigger a respin where the Matadors are kept sticky. Landing a Toro when Matadors are in view or landing a Matadors when a Toro is in view, trigger the Toro Goes Wild feature. During the feature, Toro knocks off and defeats all Matadors, leaving a trail of wild symbols behind.
